CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2857 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d. Bus nonce: 2cd60e59bf0218c7843fca6e6d056e11. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d` or `Fix review: blocked 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2cd60e59bf0218c7843fca6e6d056e11`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2857 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2857-2cd60e59`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

FULL REVIEW (record-shaped) of #2857 (roster batch 19), head 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d, bus nonce 2cd60e59bf0218c7843fca6e6d056e11, against dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA. The pull request (branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr14) changes dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json and its delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2857.md only. Authored roster tip 63b1cfd03d913abb3b1117a3d913506889024c74 (handoff/audit-r10-roster), merge of origin/main 52d58f4b6, row commit 9deee69ad. If #2851 (batch 18, MERGE verdict at e666f058) has merged by the time you read, measure the diff against the current origin/main; if not, the head still carries batch 18's nine ops (head 78d071da8 is its ancestor) and the three-dot diff is larger than ten ops: say which you saw. Check:
- every op cites a merged ruling or merged PR (commit message, op note, or the carry text's reference); name any that cites neither. For each set-stage done: verify its PR merged by the ref (git merge-base --is-ancestor <merge commit> origin/main; #2825 merged as ed1c9045e140b14e6a98fdb642942b6fa39aca71, #2848 as e0ffb12130436f1cef00e770aed436ac8b4f067e), reading the ref, not the record. done-before-reroute: every carry of a group set to done was re-routed or dropped with a stated reason before the stage changed (check each of the six dropped carries against the landed PR it names).
- carry 4 of R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS appears verbatim on R10-FLOW-JIDOKA and R10-REPLAY-REAL-DAY's appended carry is not a duplicate of an existing one (compare the full texts); no carry was dropped without re-routing (python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2857: 0 unrouted).
- the group count is unchanged (the body claims 197 and 197, none added or removed): count at origin/main and at the head and print both; R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS carry count 6 to 0 and stage done; JSON loads and the roster lint passes (run it).
- the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2857.md is in the three-dot diff (git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD), and the diff touches nothing else: VERSION, manifest, RELEASE_NOTES and both claim files untouched.
- node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs on the merged tree prints 0 errors; run it. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD exits 0.
Read CI on this head from the check-runs API and name every red (governance / delivery-status is not required; a red on the installation rate limit, HTTP 403 or RATE-LIMITED, died before any test body and is infra: say so, do not call it a finding). Re-read refs/pull/2857/head with git ls-remote before writing.
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. First line exactly "Fix review: merge 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d" or "Fix review: blocked 9deee69ad12ff84e117b806137e234c5df3bf83d <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: 2cd60e59bf0218c7843fca6e6d056e11". Then sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>"; the rest under "## Evidence" with files under ev/, one holding the full 40-hex head. Return it on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2857-2cd60e59. Do NOT run bus.sh.
